title: The divergence law is the closed form once a metric is declared

statements.text: Once a carrier volume form and a Lorentzian metric are declared, the closed three-form law and the vector law $\nabla_\mu J^\mu = 0$ are two representations of one continuity statement.

sources.quote: The closed three-form law and the covariant vector-divergence law are equivalent representations of the same continuity statement once the carrier volume form has been declared.
